about_item: Strong Absorbent & Streak-Free: Crafted with premium microfiber, these cleaning rags quickly absorb water and wipe away spills, dust, grease, and dirt without leaving streaks. Ideal for drying dishes, cleaning countertops, or polishing surfaces in the kitchen, car, or around the home.

Soft & Lint-Free on Delicate Surfaces: Made from a non-abrasive blend of 85% polyester and 15% nylon, our microfiber cloths are gentle yet effective. They won’t scratch paint, glass, or delicate surfaces, and leave no lint behind—perfect for cleaning mirrors, electronics, stainless steel, and other smooth surfaces.

Durable Construction for Long-Term Use: Designed with reinforced stitching, these cleaning cloths are not only reusable but also resist wear and tear even after frequent washing. A reliable alternative to disposable paper towels for everyday cleaning.

Multi-Color Convenience for Any Task: Available in 4 assorted colors—Pink, Green, Blue, and Purple—for easy color-coding. Use different cleaning towels for the kitchen, bathroom, car, or electronics. Stay organized and keep your cleaning tasks clearly separated.

Machine Washable & Quick-Drying: Each microfiber cloth measures 11.8" x 11.8", making them compact and easy to store. They can be washed by hand or machine. Quick-drying and always ready for your next cleaning job.

product_details.product_care_instructions: Machine wash in cold or warm water. Do not bleach. Tumble dry low or air dry.

summary.text: Customers find these cleaning cloths effective, noting they clean surfaces without streaks and work well for both indoor and outdoor use. They are highly absorbent, with one customer mentioning they absorb more than half a roll of paper towels, and customers appreciate their softness and durability after multiple uses. Customers like the color options, which help keep the cloths separate, though opinions about thickness are mixed.
